verdict.rationale: Pulley documents its own export of the cap table to Excel, either as of a specific date or for all time. That covers the core equity ledger in a widely readable spreadsheet format, but nothing shows a full export of all account data or a documented exit path. Missing for 10: export of all data beyond the cap table (documents, signatures, 409A reports, transaction history), explicitly open formats such as CSV/JSON, a bulk or account-wide export or offboarding process, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Cap Tables can be downloaded as of a specific date or for all time.
